---
title: "6.4b The typst_raw() helper"
format: typst
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| include: false
typst_raw <- function(x) {
  cat("\n```{=typst}\n")
  cat(x, sep = "\n")
  cat("\n```\n")
}
best_animal <- "otters"
best_count <- 41
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
typst_raw(sprintf(
  '#rect(fill: rgb("#fff4e8"), inset: 10pt, radius: 4pt)[*%s* appear in *%d* titles.]',
  best_animal, best_count
))
```
